0: Welcome to the Battle Frontier!\nYou on the list?\r...Everybody on the list.\nIt's a free event. Come on in!\r
1:
Oh! You got a Vs. Recorder!
Nice!We upgrade 'em for newbies so
they work at the Frontier.Lemme borrow that real quick.Slide this open... ticka-tacka...
KA-CHUNK!I ain't break it. It's fine.
Here you go. Good as new. Better.
3: The other staff gon' break down\neach facility.\rI handle the general stuff. And the\nguest list. And the snack table.\fYou got questions? {YESNO 0}
4: What you want me to explain? {YESNO 0}
5:
The Battle Frontier got five spots
just for scrappin'.Battle Tower: beat seven Hustlers
in a row. No breaks.Battle Hall: one homie, keep a
record for each one.Battle Factory: win streaks with
rental homies.Battle Castle: budget your Castle
Points. Like rent.Battle Arcade: a wheel decide your
fate. Like a casino with fists.Hit any of 'em you want!
6:
All five got special rules.First off, you don't earn no
Exp. Points. Zero.So your homies ain't levelin' up
here. They just suffer.Level 50 rule: higher-level homies
get knocked down to Lv. 50.Under Lv. 50? Roll in as is.
No free levels. No handouts.
7:
Battle Points, or BP.BP only work here at the Frontier.
Outside, it's worth nothin'. Tried payin' rent with it once.You earn BP by hittin' goals at
the facilities.Then cash it in at the Exchange
Service Corner!
8: The Exchange Service Corner is them\ntwo tents straight ahead.\rCash in your BP for prizes.\nThe dude in there never sleeps.\fWe checked. He don't.\r
9: The Performance Monitor show your\nlast record and your best record.\fThere's one by the front desk in\fevery facility.\rIt also shows when you lose.\nPublicly. Forever.\r
10: Enjoy your visit!\nNo outside food. I see that sandwich.

19: Enjoy your visit!\nDon't touch the plants. They real.
20: Welcome to the Battle Frontier!\rWant me to explain how the\nBattle Factory work? {YESNO 0}
21:
The Battle Factory is in the top-
right corner.It's a tournament with rental
homies. Like a rental car, but it bites.Keep winnin' as long as you can.Every W, you can swap one of yours
for one of the other guy's homies. Legal robbery!
22: Enjoy your visit!\nThe bathroom code is 1234.
23: Welcome to the Battle Frontier!\rWant me to explain how the\nBattle Hall work? {YESNO 0}
24:
The Battle Hall is in the top-left
corner.One homie. One-on-one scraps.
No tag-outs. No crying.Keep that win streak alive as
long as you can.
25: Enjoy your visit!\nIf you see Argenta, act natural.
26: Welcome to the Battle Frontier!\rWant me to explain how the\nBattle Castle work? {YESNO 0}
27:
The Battle Castle is in the bottom-
left corner.You get Castle Points, CP, and you
gotta budget 'em.CP pay for healin', rentin' items,
Berries, all that.Keep your streak alive while you
manage your money. It's basically adulthood.
28: Enjoy your visit!\nBring a calculator for the Castle.
29: Welcome to the Battle Frontier!\rWant me to explain how the\nBattle Arcade work? {YESNO 0}
30:
The Battle Arcade is in the bottom-
right corner.A game board spin before every
scrap. Wherever it land... somethin' go DOWN.Some events help you.
Some straight-up ruin your life.Sometimes you skip the scrap
entirely. Lucky.Keep that streak alive, gambler.
31: Enjoy your visit!\nThe Arcade don't do refunds.
32:
The Battle Frontier right there!
I been all over the world, but nothin' hit like this!What kinda Hustlers I'mma see?
What scraps I'mma get into?It's a whole new adventure!
I already lost my wallet. Good start.
